strengths: Full Mem0 VectorStoreBase protocol — 12 Python methods
GIL correctly released in ALL 10 py.detach() calls (no regression like litellm)
Proper metadata type conversion (py_any_to_vanta_value handles Bool/String/Int/Float/list variants)
Score conversion function between VantaDB distances and Mem0 scores
No unsafe, no expect, no dead unwrap paths
weaknesses: delete_col() only deletes first page — data loss over 100 records
search() silently drops text query — vector-only
update() TOCTOU between detach(get) and detach(put)
Collection name sanitization lazy — effective namespace differs from collection_name
Test coverage weak (8 tests, no error paths)
comparison: Best of the 4 adapter crates by far. 407L vs ~160L for openai/ollama/litellm. Full Mem0 protocol, correct GIL everywhere, proper type conversion. Still has real issues (delete_col pagination data loss is the standout).
